verdict.rationale: Jira's own marketing says users can create custom automations and rules through Rovo AI, an apparently no-code, AI-assisted path, and that automation connects tools to Jira workflows. However, the evidence never documents a rule builder, chained or multi-step actions, or a no-code interface usable by non-developers. Customizable status workflows are a related feature and do not count as automation. Missing for 10: documented multi-step rule composition (trigger, conditions, multiple actions), explicit no-code visual builder docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of PMs building automations.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build multi-step automations without writing code

citations.quote: Use Rovo AI to create custom automations to keep your status up to date - from automated reminders to rules that move work forward.
Connect your tools to any Jira workflow with automation. Whether your team is using Bitbucket, Slack, or any other tool, automation keeps Jira up to date, so you don't have to.
